criteria_origin: Pinned candidate numerical design choices; not biological error tolerances

families.name: Capillary pressure balance
families.fixture: Sphere mesh with constant bare gamma and no cohesive or active forcing
families.acceptance: relative pressure error <=1e-4 under geometric refinement

families.name: Cohesive loading work
families.acceptance: quadrature loading work/W0 error <=1e-6; peak and completion match delta0/deltaf

families.name: Damage irreversibility and unloading
families.fixture: Load above onset, unload, reload and close
families.acceptance: kappa and damage never decrease; no traction recovery after d=1; event history survives rollback

families.name: Membrane osmotic equilibrium
families.fixture: Known equal hydrostatic/osmotic driving with active pumping disabled
families.acceptance: normalized net water flux <=1e-10; independent sign tests for water and solute

families.name: Water and solute budgets
families.fixture: Closed cell-fluid network and separate driven bath-boundary fixture
families.acceptance: closed final relative budgets <=1e-8; driven signed boundary budget <=1e-7

families.name: Analytic two-compartment diffusion
families.fixture: Fixed volumes and Q=0 with known diffusive conductance
families.acceptance: concentration difference matches exponential decay within 1e-3; inventory conserved

families.name: Advection and positivity
families.fixture: Manufactured transport with explicit inlet/outlet boundary inventories
families.acceptance: upwind donor consistency, no negative accepted amount, normalized analytic error <=1e-3 under refinement

families.name: Passive mechanical dissipation
families.fixture: Disable active pump, imposed active-tension variation and bath driving
families.acceptance: energy-accounting residual <=1e-6; viscosity/drag/damage dissipation nonnegative; no fabricated equilibrium requirement

families.name: Spatial refinement
families.fixture: Two successive mesh and fluid-volume partition refinements with identical physical coefficients
families.acceptance: dominant-cavity fraction and coarsening time change <=1%; cavity centroid displacement <=0.05 L_ref; independent geometry and transport refinement

families.name: Temporal and event refinement
families.fixture: Two successive timestep halvings; matched reference event sequence
families.acceptance: fraction/time change <=0.5%; centroid displacement <=0.025 L_ref; event localization <=1e-4 t_ref; smooth-window backward-Euler order target [0.8,1.2]

families.name: Rejection rollback and resource halt
families.fixture: Injected invalid trial, failed nonlinear solve and exhausted step/event budget
families.acceptance: no accepted-state or ledger mutation; exact last-accepted checkpoint restored; explicit NUMERICAL_HALT receipt

families.name: Partial contact and exterior seal isolation
families.fixture: One patch fails while another stays bound, then all fail
families.acceptance: adhesive edge persists until all patches fail; exterior leak topology unchanged by internal failure

families.name: Conservative topology event maps
families.fixture: Nucleation reclassification, drainage to background clefts and merger
families.acceptance: both water and solute remap residual <=1e-10; no inventory insertion/deletion or forced pressure equality

families.name: Scope and input refusal
families.fixture: Repair, division, excessive shear, non-slender/slit-Re, invalid mixing, invalid initial history
families.acceptance: MODEL_SCOPE_EXCEEDED or UNRESOLVED as appropriate; no silent branch substitution

families.name: Symmetry equivariance
families.fixture: Rotate initial geometry and relabel cells/compartments in an otherwise identical run
families.acceptance: rotated centroid residual <=0.01 L_ref; scalar trajectory changes <=1e-4; no unrecorded lumen seeds

families.name: Cohort lineage and batch boundaries
families.fixture: Shared dam across splits, repeated litters, shared dish, missing lineage, high batch entropy
families.acceptance: cross-cluster splits invalid; unknown lineage unresolved; entropy never grants independence or admission

families.name: Frozen-environment replay
families.fixture: Same binary/environment/input hashes and canonical mesh/edge order
families.acceptance: same event groups and output counts; normalized continuous-field discrepancy <=1e-12 on same approved platform
